cases.prompt:
Task/authority: Verify whether this Android candidate is ready for a 5% phased production release; do not sign, upload, submit, access credentials, or change rollout state.
Identity: Android `com.example.wallet`, v6.5.0 build 65017; `wallet-6.5.0-65017.aab`; SHA-256 `8d7a2e7118b3c6d2a824ee18f7fe30e580e4093a77bdb7868321b2ea1f901234`; Git `3f61c9e`; CI `android-release/8821`. Gradle/dependency lockfiles clean; reproducibility check matched the hash. Play App Signing certificate fingerprint ends `:7A:91`; owner Mobile Release Engineering; no signing key/credential supplied or authorized. Channel: Google Play production, phased to 5% of Italy/Spain accounts.
Scope/matrix: Supported Android 10–15 phones/tablets; foldables and ChromeOS explicitly unsupported. Candidate-artifact tests (not static inspection) verified Android 10 Pixel 3a, 11 Galaxy A20, 12 Galaxy Tab S7, 13 Pixel 4a, 14 Galaxy A14, and 15 Pixel 8 for install, first launch, login, payment, offline recovery, background/foreground, interruption, deep link, push notification, logout, account deletion, and upgrade from oldest supported 6.3.0 schema. TalkBack/font scaling verified on Android 12/14/15; English/Italian/Spanish localization verified on phone/tablet. Android 10 TalkBack and Japanese localization were not assessed; Japanese is outside release locales, but Android 10 accessibility is an explicit gap. No journey or listed device failed.
Permissions/privacy/migration: Only camera/notifications requested; denial of each passed. Play Data Safety matches collected diagnostics/payment-token handling; privacy review `PRIV-771` approved. No new SDK, permission, entitlement, or data category. Migration integrity passed on 12 seeded account histories.
Backend/operations: API contract supports clients 6.3–6.5 through 2026-10-31. `wallet_v65` defaults off; remote disable exercised in staging. Store assets/declarations reviewed. ProGuard mapping/native symbols: `ci://android-release/8821/artifacts`; crash-symbolication test passed. Support/incident owner: Elena Bianchi.
Controls: Observe 6 hours at 5%; automatically halt if crash-free users <99.7%, payment failures >0.5%, or migration errors >0.1% for 15 minutes. Elena Bianchi has halt authority. Retain backend compatibility 60 days. If store rollback unavailable, remotely disable feature and ship forward-fix 65018.
Output: Return `## Candidate identity`, `## Evidence matrix`, `## Rollout controls`, `## Readiness decision`, in order. Bind artifact/build to revision, pipeline, signing metadata, and production channel. Mark every journey and device class verified, failed, not assessed, or blocked; never pass missing evidence, especially Android 10 accessibility.
